top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that feeding tubes are  not used unless there is a medical reason and the resident agrees; and provide appropriate care for a resident with a feeding tube.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.
Make sure that the nursing home area is safe, easy to use, clean and comfortable for residents, staff and the public.
Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
